Funding for Monoclonal Antibodies Against Viral Infections
summary: This call aims to support the development of prophylactic and therapeutic monoclonal antibody candidates targeting specific Flaviviruses such as Dengue, Tick-borne Encephalitis, Japanese Encephalitis, West Nile Fever, Yellow Fever, and Zika. Funded activities include in-vitro and in-vivo testing, GMP batch production, and first-in-human clinical safety studies. Eligible applicants include research entities, universities, start-ups, and SMEs from EU member states and associated countries forming consortia.
